prompt:
Use case: clean anatomical educational photorealistic visual learning asset for the Hanzi 心; subject ID heart only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych containing exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, separated by two narrow straight white horizontal seams approximately 8 pixels thick near y=597 and y=1195. No outer border.
Subject/material: the same complete physical human anatomical heart teaching model, an obviously manufactured non-gory painted plastic classroom model of the external human heart. Muted reddish-brown plastic myocardium, modeled branching coronary vessels and anatomically placed red and blue great-vessel stubs at the upper end. A small simple unlabeled support and pale tabletop may hold it upright. Natural organ silhouette with a tapered apex, NOT a symmetrical love-heart symbol. No dissection or exposed internal chambers.
Top photograph: direct anterior/front view of the complete human heart teaching model, showing the front surface, descending anterior coronary vessels, great vessels above and tapered apex below. Entire model and support are visible.
Middle photograph: true side view of that same complete teaching model, rotated about ninety degrees relative to the front photograph, clearly revealing the depth and side contour of the organ and vessels. This must be a genuinely different side view, not another front view.
Bottom photograph: direct posterior/back view of the same teaching model, rotated about one hundred eighty degrees from the front photograph. Show the posterior anatomical surface, vessel arrangements on the back and the upper posterior atrial and pulmonary-vein region. This must be the rear surface, not a mirrored or repeated anterior view.
Composition/framing: exactly three standalone wide landscape product photographs in front, side, back order; one complete model centered in each panel, with at least 12 percent clear safe margin around every vessel tip, apex and supporting base. Calm uncluttered pale tabletop and neutral backdrop. Similar camera distance across panels, consistent model design and medically plausible external anatomy.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic photography of a physical educational plastic model, visible subtly matte manufactured surface and paint texture, soft natural window light, believable shadows and natural material colors. It must look like a photographed classroom object, not a graphic, cartoon or CGI rendering.
Constraints: human anatomical heart teaching model ONLY, never a love-heart icon, romantic symbol, real organ, surgery photograph, bloody tissue or gore. No people, hands, medical procedures or tools. No text, numbers, labels, writing, captions, logos, brands, watermark or decorative graphics. Exactly three panels and two thin white seams.
reviewNotes: Inspected only the 300x525 JPEG preview. All three panels show manufactured anatomical human-heart teaching models on white circular stands, with reddish-brown surfaces and red/blue modeled vessels, not love-heart symbols or real organs. Top shows the anterior surface and descending vessels; middle shows a distinct side/oblique view with lateral vessel openings, not a strict verified ninety-degree profile; bottom shows a posterior surface with a broad upper atrial region and different vessel arrangement. Front/side/back contexts are distinguishable, but detailed anatomical accuracy and exact model consistency are not verified at preview resolution. Vessel tips, apexes and stands are intact; vertical margins are smaller than requested 12 percent. No visible blood, gore, people, labels or watermark. Sharp measured white seam rows 589–597 and 1185–1193 in the 1024x1792 source; centers 593 and 1189.
